answer: Standing decays sharply after 8 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The walnut decay curve is applied at each close, onyx records the drop, and knoll recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks therefore finds them worthless when it returns to them. The attacker spends 163 dollars and 13 days per identity before it can vote at all.
